standard.summary: IP-Adapter 允许用参考图像作为额外条件输入训练。模型学习从图像特征中提取风格/内容信息，实现图像驱动的生成控制。
standard.effect: ip_adapter_scale 控制图像条件的强度。ip_adapter_num_image_tokens 控制图像特征注入的 token 数量。ip_adapter_cond_mode 控制注入方式（concat/cross-attn）。
standard.whenToUse: 想训练图像驱动的风格迁移或参考图生成时。
standard.avoidWhen: 增加训练复杂度和显存开销。推理时需要提供图像条件。

standard_en.summary: IP-Adapter lets a reference image serve as an extra conditioning input during training. The model learns to extract style and content information from image features, giving image-driven control over generation.
standard_en.effect: ip_adapter_scale sets the image condition's strength. ip_adapter_num_image_tokens sets how many tokens the image features are injected as. ip_adapter_cond_mode sets how they are injected (concat / cross-attn).
standard_en.whenToUse: When training image-driven style transfer or reference-image generation.
standard_en.avoidWhen: It adds complexity and VRAM cost, and inference requires an image condition to be supplied.

advanced.principle: IP-Adapter 使用 CLIP image encoder 提取参考图像的特征向量，通过 cross-attention 或 concat 方式注入 UNet。ip_image_encoder_path 指定 image encoder 模型。ip_num_tokens 控制注入的 image token 数量（SD1.5 默认 4，SDXL 默认 16）。
advanced.intervention: 在 UNet 中添加 IP-Adapter cross-attention 层。训练时同时优化 LoRA 和 IP-Adapter 权重。
advanced.expectedImpact: 实现图像条件的生成控制。需要专门的推理管线。
advanced.tradeoffs: easy_control_enabled 是更简单的图像条件方案。

advanced_en.principle: IP-Adapter uses a CLIP image encoder to extract the reference image's feature vector, injected into the UNet via cross-attention or concat. ip_image_encoder_path specifies the image-encoder model. ip_num_tokens controls the number of injected image tokens (SD1.5 default 4, SDXL default 16).
advanced_en.intervention: Adds IP-Adapter cross-attention layers to the UNet. Training optimizes LoRA and IP-Adapter weights together.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Enables image-conditioned generation control. Needs a dedicated inference pipeline.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: easy_control_enabled is the simpler image-conditioning scheme.
